0115dcb814fb399d57ccd4a4fc2816c3.overview: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has a savant older brother named Raymond and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.
0115dcb814fb399d57ccd4a4fc2816c3.tagline: A journey through understanding and fellowship.

0120ffb5fadf84e89c4648a352b66bc5.overview: An alien is left behind on Earth and saved by the 10-year-old Elliott who decides to keep him hidden in his home. While a task force hunts for the extra-terrestrial, Elliott, his brother, and his little sister Gertie form an emotional bond with their new friend, and try to help him find his way home.
0120ffb5fadf84e89c4648a352b66bc5.tagline: He is afraid. He is totally alone. He is 3,000,000 light years from home.

013af0202ae0176b2ec50d7c91287694.overview: Stephen Neale is released into WWII England after two years in an asylum, but it doesn't seem so sane outside either. On his way back to London to rejoin civilization, he stumbles across a murderous spy ring and doesn't quite know  to whom to turn.
013af0202ae0176b2ec50d7c91287694.tagline: Thrilling drama of the Invisible Network of Terror!

017f20b8031a88d259488ab52cbaf704.overview: Anabel Sims is determined to find the perfect husband. She thinks she's found her man in Madison Brown, a handsome pediatrician. She then prepares an elaborate scheme to trap him into marriage
017f20b8031a88d259488ab52cbaf704.tagline: He won't say "YES"! She won't take "NO"!

0192da4017e19e4727f3b095de3e9067.overview: In the upscale Toronto strip club Exotica, dancer Christina is visited nightly by the obsessive Francis, a depressed tax auditor. Her ex-boyfriend, the club's MC, Eric, still jealously pines for her even as he introduces her onstage, but Eric is having his own relationship problems with the club's female owner. Thomas, a mysterious pet-shop owner, is about to become unexpectedly involved in their lives.
0192da4017e19e4727f3b095de3e9067.tagline: In a world of temptation, obsession is the deadliest desire.

01a8fe85668048023372a6b15c2dffa1.overview: The true story of mountain climber Aron Ralston's remarkable adventure to save himself after a fallen boulder crashes on his arm and traps him in an isolated canyon in Utah.

01b56651ffef2b3e2c1bdb0da7a455d3.overview: Tony spends his Saturdays at a disco where his stylish moves raise his popularity among the patrons. But his life outside the disco is not easy and things change when he gets attracted to Stephanie.
01b56651ffef2b3e2c1bdb0da7a455d3.tagline: Where do you go when the record is over...

01da104d6aca610ff110fa87134aeed8.overview: A drive-in favorite, this sci-fi classic follows teenagers Steve and his best girl, Jane, as they try to protect their hometown from a gelatinous alien life form that engulfs everything it touches. The first to discover the substance and live to tell about it, Steve and Jane witness the blob destroying an elderly man, then it growing to a terrifying size. But no one else has seen the goo, and policeman Dave refuses to believe the kids without proof.
01da104d6aca610ff110fa87134aeed8.tagline: It crawls. It creeps. It eats you alive!

01de491cadf32e09f927797ef0990a2b.overview: A brash American gramophone salesman tries to get Emperor Franz Joseph's endorsement in turn-of-the-century Austria.
01de491cadf32e09f927797ef0990a2b.tagline: Bing hits the high notes! Joan hits the love notes! You'll hit a happy note... in this king-sized muscial wonder!

01ef917b49548f8196d673e6a1c3e4e0.overview: Veteran catcher Crash Davis is brought to the minor league Durham Bulls to help their up and coming pitching prospect, "Nuke" Laloosh. Their relationship gets off to a rocky start and is further complicated when baseball groupie Annie Savoy sets her sights on the two men.
01ef917b49548f8196d673e6a1c3e4e0.tagline: Romance is a lot like baseball. It's not whether you win or lose. It's how you play the game.
